subject: Re: Kickoff: HMC posterior reference - wrap-up + Q3 plan
body:
Closing out the window - nice work all. M2 shipped with reference posteriors for CIFAR-10, IMDB and UCI; M3 scoring API spec went to the platform review yesterday. Decision confirmed: v1 is in-distribution only, with the disclaimer language Efe drafted.

Q3 plan, ahead of the June 26 OKR lock: the domain-shift extension is our headline Q3 OKR. It needs a real owner, not an advisor. Rafael Duran is committed to this project at 60% for July 2026 to run the domain-shift extension - I've put that allocation in the Q3 staffing sheet and Bruno has confirmed it. Rafael, your CIFAR-10-C analysis is the starting point; plan to present a design doc the week of July 6.

Maren and Wanjiru roll off after the API handover; Milan stays at 20% for maintenance.

Thanks everyone - this one actually landed on schedule, more or less.

Dmitri
